reviews.title: Pros, Neutrals, & Cons
reviews.text:
Pros: Teaches coding, works on iPhone, has many different types of coding lessons.

Neutrals: Gives you certificates. Unclear whether these mean anything or are just cool to have.

Cons: Many lessons were obviously written by people who don’t English as the first language. I mean it’s great they try their best though, but sometimes that can be a little distracting or confusing. But the much worse con is that if you pay for the lifetime subscription to the pro model, you will find out in a couple years that it isn’t a lifetime subscription. And that tapping “Restore Purchase” will not work. But if you’re fine with dishonesty and having to re-pay the $40-ish every few years then it’s not an issue for you.

reviews.title: Super buggy :(
reviews.text:
I like to use this app as an easy intro to a new topic. I like the cheat sheet of key words with quick explanations and examples. And the courses are pretty easy to understand for a shallow overview before I look to other sources. 

But to be 100% honest, this app is not the best way to learn a new coding language. There’s lots of typos. There’s lots of coding errors that cause the app to render incorrectly and make some of the content unreadable (This is highly unideal for a literal coding app). The certificates do not stick, no matter how many times you re-earn them. So many buttons do not work and are obviously just there for show. And it crashes. All the time.

I am happy to continue using this app as my introduction to learning a new skill app. It fulfills that purpose very well! But please just fix the constant crashing,, Sometimes it won’t even let me open the app before crashing. Other times, like right now, it crashes every time I go into the programs tab for sql.

reviews.title: It used to be good...
reviews.text:
First off, I would like to say that I used to love programming hub. The UI was easy to navigate, it was quick enough, and there weren't really any issues with the text.
As of about a year or two ago, however, a lot has changed.

The UI is slow and clunky. There isn't an easy or quick way to access your certificates, making it a hassle to access even one. There is also a course that I have completed, but the "unlock certificate" button simply does nothing.
The biggest problem with this app is the text. I'm not sure who wrote half of these courses, but it's trash. Many lessons are littered with grammatical mistakes and many others have false information. 
I would love to recommend programming hub. After all, it won an award in 2017. It seems some time after that though, they gave up. I want to see improvements again. When I want to learn a new language, I want to WANT to go to this app to learn, but it's just such a hassle and not the best way to learn anything it seems.

reviews.title: SCAM! Paid for nothing!
reviews.text:
I paid the $36 anniversary offer for the pro membership which should’ve been for a lifetime. I purchased this back in 2022. I’ve been trying to gain access to the pro courses 
 and it says that I don’t have a subscription. I reached out to technical support they told me to provide all of the proof of payment which I did. I got a response that everything was fixed and it would work. It didn’t work!! I reached out to them again! I had to provide the same information again and 2 more times after that. I’ve only gotten the run around. I keep getting the same responses- how they understand and they apologize and they’re gonna transfer me to technical support. After no one got back to me I tried to reply again and it says I exceeded the maximum allowed exchanges. Apparently I’ll be getting a refund. If it actually goes through I will gladly come back and update my review!
